newsitem.title: USA: Musicland's banks approve financing plan.
newsitem.headline: Musicland's banks approve financing plan.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said on Monday that its bank group has approved an amendment to its bank agreement, giving it more financial flexibility during the fourth quarter.
Under the terms of the new agreement, the company will have to reduce its debt to $275 million by December 20 and stay at or below that level through September 11, 1997, the company said.
Musicland had previously been required to pay down its revolver balance to $25 million for one day prior to February 15, 1997, the entertainment retailer said in a news release.
If appropriate, the company will be able to close additional underperforming stores after the holiday season under the amended agreement, the company said.
Given lower anticipated borrowing needs next year, the overall borrowing cap after September 11 will be $300 million, down from $350 million, the company said.
